notes: Availability is not evidence of reachability or quota.
A route failure is retained as a failed probe and is never replaced by a different route without a new protocol record.
Model route names are data and must not be stripped from analysis artifacts.
The 2026-09-07 smoke used one repetition per route. It is diagnostic only; no route is admitted from that smoke alone.
Only the daosyduyminh identity was configured for this campaign. No second-account credential root was present.
The 2026-09-09 ai-race-frontier-admission-v6 campaign added five routes to this list and audited nine in total; artefacts and the derived table are in results/frontier/admission_campaign_v6/.

Nine routes were audited on 2026-09-09 under ai-race-frontier-admission-v6 and five were admitted: google/gemini-3-flash-preview, anthropic/claude-opus-5@default, openai/gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, openai/gpt-5.5-2026-04-23 and anthropic/claude-sonnet-5@default. Four were refused: google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, openai/gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite and openai/gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17. Every verdict recorded in this file is a copy of results/frontier/admission_campaign_v6/derived/admission_campaign_v6.csv, which is the source of truth.

Four routes in this list carry no v6 verdict: deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1-0528, qwen/qwen3-next-80b-a3b-instruct, openai/gpt-oss-120b and ibm/granite-4.0-h-small. Their earlier admission attempts are retained as failed runs under results/frontier/admission_campaign/, admission_campaign_v5/ and admission_smoke/, and they were not retried in the v6 campaign.

Eight of the nine audited routes also have a matched gameplay baseline under ai-race-frontier-baseline-v3 in results/frontier/baseline_campaign_v6/, 30 races and 558 decisions and zero parse failures each; google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite has none because its gameplay run failed in transport with zero races.
